{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of baseline biomarker by sex
baseline_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_baseline'].describe()

# Check the distribution of final biomarker by sex
final_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['biomarker_final'].describe()

# Compute the average improvement (final - baseline) by sex, excluding sentinel values
# Replace sentinel with NaN
df_clean = df.copy()
df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute improvement only where baseline is not missing
improvement = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']
response_mask = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].notna()

# Compute average improvement by sex
avg_improvement_by_sex = improvement[response_mask].groupby(df_clean.loc[response_mask, 'sex']).mean()

# Also compute total response rate by sex (from responded column)
response_rate_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Print all
print(baseline_by_sex)
print(final_by_sex)
print(avg_improvement_by_sex)
print(response_rate_by_sex)"}
